description: Lines around a heading that the wiki parser's anchors must not turn into another block. Each case is checked twice: tests/dom/markdown-wiki-parser-behavior.js counts its anchors and checks that removing them restores the source, and tests/test_markdown_obsidian_fixture.py renders it through /api/kpress/render as authored and as preprocessed, which must give the same HTML once the anchors are removed.

cases.name: list item above a thematic break
numbered list item above its lazy line
block quote above a thematic break
one-column table above its delimiter row
heading underline above a thematic break
thematic break above a thematic break
footnote definition above a thematic break
container above a thematic break
indented setext heading
empty heading with a closing sequence
heading named by its closing character
empty ATX heading above a thematic break
empty ATX heading above an equals line
line indented to column 4 by a tab
table row without outer pipes above a thematic break
one-column table with a trailing pipe
one-column table with an escaped pipe
ATX heading with a pipe in its text
image alone directly above an ATX heading stays a figure
ATX heading directly after a table adds no row
known approximation: setext text that reads as a definition is refused
